title: Affine morphisms of a pulled-back affine intersection
statement: Let $f:X\to T$ be separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], $U\subseteq T$ affine, and $Z\subseteq Y=f^{-1}U$ an affine open. For any cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with maps $g:T^\prime\to U$, $g^\prime:X^\prime\to X$, and $f^\prime:X^\prime\to T^\prime$, put $W=(g^\prime)^{-1}(j_Y(Z))$, where $j_Y:Y\hookrightarrow X$ is the open inclusion. Both $W\hookrightarrow X^\prime$ and $W\to T^\prime$ are affine morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. No affineness of $T^\prime$ is assumed.

proof.text: The restriction square defining Y is cartesian. Lift gprime and fprime composed with g to k:Xprime -> Y. Cancellation of the restriction square from the supplied square makes (k,fprime,p,g) cartesian, where p=f restricted to U.

Z -> U is affine because both schemes are affine. Restrict k to Z and paste its cartesian restriction square with the previous square. Thus W -> Tprime is the base change of Z -> U and is affine. Here k inverse image Z equals gprime inverse image jY(Z) by the lift equation and injectivity of the open immersion.

Separatedness of fprime follows by base change from f. Mathlib IsAffineHom.of_comp applied to W -> Xprime -> Tprime then makes W -> Xprime affine. This is the relative affine-over-base/separated-over-base criterion of Stacks 01S5, Lemma 29.11.12(2).

proof_origin.place: Tags 01S5, Lemmas 29.11.9, 29.11.12 and 29.11.13; Tag 01KP; explicit Lean reduction by F1

from.place: Coherence unit part (a), finite affine Cech cover: affineness of the intersection morphisms after base change

lean.statement:
theorem finiteAffineCech_intersection_baseChange {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T)
    [IsSeparated f] (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hZ : IsAffineOpen Z)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι)) :
    IsAffineHom (g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z)).ι ∧
      IsAffineHom ((g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z)).ι ≫ f')
